material.rule: AQS-STD-002 Rev F, rules M2 and M5. Leach liquor 70-85 C (GLOSSARY Leach/Salria; AQS-DUTY-008 HX-5 basis 77.5 C) exceeds PVC-U 60 C; CPVC to 93 C [S3]. No metal wetted part.

density_kg_m3.note: Spears engineering guide, CPVC specific gravity 1.51 [S3].

material.temperature_check: Liquor 77.5 C design, 70-85 C band (graph param liquor_T_C). CPVC limit 93 C [S3]; high trip 88 C (assumption). HX-5 coil and ports PVDF for Q3 water at 95 C (AQS-STD-002 3.2). Wall strength at temperature is held under the LEACH_CSTR_1 sizing task.

header_zone_mm.note: Assumption. Depth reserved on each Y face inside the envelope for the inlet and outlet headers.

wall_mm.note: From AQS-NZ-001 (CSTR_NOZZLE_SCHEDULE.md) sheet wall 12 mm, now PVC. Not checked against hydrostatic load; liquor density is held.

floor_mm.note: From AQS-NZ-001 floor 16 mm, now PVC.

lid_bolt.note: Assumption. Non-metallic fasteners in the acid-gas head space (AQS-STD-002 M4).

header_od_mm.note: Assumption. 2 in Sch 80 PVC, ASTM D1785 OD.

port_od_mm_bore_not_calculated.note: Assumption. 1 in Sch 80 PVC placeholder; bore not calculated.

port_pitch_mm.note: Assumption. Ports spread along X about the face center at Z 700.

hx5_coil.basis: AQS-DUTY-049, natural convection case (agitator held), 7.941 kW rated

arrangement.value: two concentric helices D 600 and 900 mm, 11.5 turns at 50 mm pitch, 600 mm tall, on four PTFE pads at z 100 mm
arrangement.note: Assumption. Envelope modeled as one annulus OD 925 / ID 575 x 600 mm.
